articles.summary: CHANDLER, Ariz. October 26, 2023 --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Offerpad Solutions Inc. (“Offerpad”) (NYSE: OPAD), a leading tech-driven platform for residential real estate operating in 14 states and over 1,000 cities, has unveiled a nationwide collaboration with Anywhere Real Estate, Inc., a global leader in residential real estate services. This program extends Offerpad's reach, allowing seller requests from areas outside of Offerpad's coverage to be served by certified agents affiliated with the Anywhere Leads Network.
articles.title: Offerpad Selects Anywhere℠ to Serve Sellers Beyond Current Market Reach
